course_name_original: Atatürk İlk. ve İnk. Tar. I
course_name_en: Atatürk's Principles and History of Revolutions I

learning_outcomes.text: Understands the necessity of studying Atatürk's Principles and History of Revolutions Course, knows the concepts of Revolution, Reform, Tanzimat, Constitutional Monarchy, Coup and Republic, distinguishes the similarities and differences between these concepts, knows historical examples related to these concepts and analyzes the elements that gave rise to the concepts through these examples.

Questions the formation of historical knowledge based on the phrase “Ottoman Empire Decline Period” and realizes the necessity of developing a critical perspective towards information obtained in any scientific field other than historical information.

Knows the 'crisis' period related to the Ottoman Empire, its internal and external dynamics, and evaluates the impact of this period on the Turkish Revolution in the context of the information obtained.

Knows the Ottoman Modernization process, the historical events and situations that emerged during this period, and evaluates the impact of this process on the Turkish Revolution in the context of the information obtained.
Knows the Eastern Question and the historical events experienced within the framework of this process.
Understands the interactions of historical events within the framework of the 'Eastern Question' concept and evaluates how this context can shape what comes after.
Within the framework of the 'Eastern Question' concept, gains insight into how past dynamics affect the present and realizes the connection between the current and the past.
Understands the spirit of the National Struggle and how it was formed.
Understands the importance of feelings such as national unity and solidarity, love for the homeland and humanity for the continuity of the Republic of Turkey.

In the in-class activities carried out within the framework of this course, knows the ways to access information, conducts resource research, uses databases and other information sources, questions the information obtained, evaluates the information obtained, and expresses evaluations in in-class activities related to the topics, acts democratically in activities carried out within the framework of the discussion method, understands the importance of respecting different ideas, adopts democratic behavior, adopts respecting human rights as a principle, evaluates differences not as separating but as constituent parts of the whole.

syllabus_topics: Necessity of studying Atatürk's Principles and History of Revolutions Course
Concepts of Revolution, Reform, Tanzimat, Constitutional Monarchy, Coup and Republic
Similarities and differences between the concepts of Revolution, Reform, Tanzimat, Constitutional Monarchy, Coup and Republic
Historical examples of these concepts and analysis of the examples

Historical foundations of the Turkish Revolution, Ottoman Empire's crisis, internal and external dynamics affecting this crisis, analysis of these dynamics and their effects on the Turkish Revolution.
Ottoman Empire's modernization efforts to preserve its existence, Tanzimat, Reform and Constitutional Monarchy processes within these efforts

Intellectual infrastructure of the modernization process and in this context, the intellectual currents of Ottomanism, Islamism, Turkism and Westernism, their effects on the Turkish Revolution and today.
Dissolution process of the Ottoman Empire, political, social, economic and cultural dynamics effective in this process
Tripolitanian War, Balkan Wars, First World War and Armistice of Mudros during the dissolution process.

The 'Eastern Question' in the Ottoman period before and during the transition to the Republic, its emergence, policies of the states involved in this issue, their effects on the Ottoman Empire, the 'Eastern Question' during the transition to the Republic / in the early years of the Republic.
Developments after the signing of the Armistice of Mudros; occupations in Anatolia, reactions to the occupations and first organizations in the National Struggle
Redd-i İlhak (Rejection of Annexation) and national sentiments shaped around this concept, effects of these occupations on the emergence of the National Struggle.
Kuva-yı Millîye (National Forces), the spirit of the National Struggle, Mustafa Kemal and his leadership in this process

Situation of the country in the face of occupations and Mustafa Kemal's search for political solutions against occupations and his political/intellectual activities in Istanbul, Mustafa Kemal Pasha's arrival in Samsun.
First step for the National Struggle, organization through congresses: Amasya, Erzurum and Sivas Congresses.
Emergence of the Misak-ı Milli (National Pact) text, elements forming this text, legal status of the said text.
Place of the Misak-ı Milli text in the establishment of the Republic of Turkey and its place and importance in the domestic and foreign policy of the Republic of Turkey today.

Opening of the First Grand National Assembly of Turkey (April 23, 1920), structure and functioning of the Grand National Assembly, rebellions that broke out after the opening of the Grand National Assembly and measures taken by the Grand National Assembly.
Treaty of Sèvres, reaction of the Grand National Assembly against the Treaty of Sèvres.
Establishment of the regular army; Eastern Front (Armenian issue, Treaty of Gümrü and its results), Southern Front (defenses of Adana, Antep, Maraş, Urfa).
Western Front (First Battle of İnönü and its results, Second Battle of İnönü, Battles of Kütahya and Eskişehir, Battle of Sakarya, Great Offensive and its results).
Armistice of Mudanya, preparations for the Lausanne Peace Conference, negotiations and signing of the treaty, important articles of the Treaty of Lausanne and its implications.
European Developments (Industrial Revolution, French Revolution) and their Effects on the Ottoman Empire
Modernization Movements in the Ottoman Empire, Tanzimat and Reform Period Developments
Constitutional Monarchy Period Developments and Intellectual Currents in the Ottoman Empire
Process Leading to the First World War (Tripolitanian War, Balkan Wars, Eastern Question and Modern Colonialism)
Ottoman Empire's Entry into the First World War and Fronts
Ottoman Empire and the World in the First World War
Developments After the First World War, Armistice of Mudros and Occupations in Anatolia
National Struggle Preparation Period, Societies, Kuvayı Milliye, Mustafa Kemal's Stance Against Occupations and His Emergence as a Leader
Congresses, Opening of the Last Ottoman Assembly of Deputies and Misâk-ı Milli
Opening of the Grand National Assembly of Turkey, Rebellions Against the Opening of the Assembly
Fronts in the National Struggle
Lausanne Peace Treaty
